title: The Fix Toolkit
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: A pegboard of thirteen tools, one for each fix in Chapter 15, hung in eight panels by the metric each mainly raises, each with a human-check badge.

educational.topic: The thirteen fixes an agent can help with, grouped by the metric each raises
learningObjectives: The learner will match each of the thirteen fixes to the metric it mainly raises, and state the human check for one of them.
prerequisites: The ten metrics from [Chapter 3](../../chapters/03-ten-metric-rubric-scoring/index.md) and the improvement plan from [Chapter 15](../../chapters/15-improving-resources-with-ai/index.md).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: What mistake should I expect, and how do I check it?
commonMisconceptions: An agent's fix can be applied without review
A fix for one metric has no side effects on the others
assessmentOpportunities: Which metric does PDF-to-Markdown conversion mainly raise?
What is the human check for link repair?
What is the typical agent mistake in metadata generation?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Numbered markers
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
